description: Per-cell c via w_ph_wood_wallis(p,h) (Wood-Wallis HEM in dome, single-phase elsewhere); Ma_cell=|u|/c; per-face beta(Ma)=clamp((Ma-lo)/(hi-lo),0,1), defaults lo=0.3 hi=1.0; config ma_blend_lo/hi + accessors + uom docs; clamp c>=c_min. Unit test: beta monotone/clamped, Ma from uniform field matches hand calc.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsiDesktop
notes.content: CORRECTION (maintainer 2026-07-16): the regime-detector AND the KNP characteristic wave speeds MUST use the HEM EQUILIBRIUM sound speed, NOT w_ph_wood_wallis (which is the frozen homogeneous speed). Use w_ps_eqm_region4_kieffer (Kieffer eq.28, region_4_vap_liq_equilibrium/speed_of_sound_eqm.rs:27; equilibrium derivatives along the saturation curve — the true HEM a_e) in the two-phase dome, and the single-phase region speeds w_tp_1/2/3/5 outside. Regime detector works from (p,h): compute s from the (p,h) flash, then call w_ps_eqm_region4_kieffer(p,s). w_ps_eqm_region4_finite_diff_vol is a simpler cross-check. Sanity-check c stays finite/positive across the Edwards trajectory (Kieffer fn is AI-generated/unvalidated).

title: B2: HEM equilibrium sound speed / Mach / beta(Ma) wiring (NOT Wood-Wallis)

description: The fix side of bead op-7pv (which carries the full measured evidence). fvc::ddt_corr (src/fv_operators/fvc/ddt_corr.rs) is Euler-only and takes no scheme argument; the BDF2/Backward scheme lives downstream in appbuilder's schemes.rs, so within basic-lib the inconsistency is LATENT (documented as such in the doc comment since 2026-08-07) and becomes active whenever a downstream solver selects Backward. Port OpenFOAM's backwardDdtScheme::fvcDdtPhiCorr and give ddt_corr a scheme parameter (enum dispatch per workspace rules). Acceptance: the temporal order-of-accuracy test from op-7pv measures ~2 for Backward. Blocks calling Backward verified second-order.
title: basic-lib: port backwardDdtScheme::fvcDdtPhiCorr — the real fix for the Euler/BDF2 ddtCorr inconsistency

description:
Maintainer request 2026-08-14. The maintainer chats with Opus through NUS AI Know (200k context) and wants to hand it the Outram Park API markdown so it can advise on how to code in, scaffold and structure solutions for this workspace.

THE BINDING CONSTRAINTS, measured 2026-08-14:
- The upload dialog takes MULTIPLE FILES but NOT FOLDERS. Output must therefore be FLAT -- one file per crate, no subdirectories.
- Budget is 200k tokens. The 13 existing crates/<crate>/docs/api.md mirrors total 5,154,447 bytes ~= 1.29 M tokens by the chars/4 estimate -- 6.5x over. outram-park-fork-offbeat alone is 928,045 bytes ~= 232k, over budget BY ITSELF. So flatten-and-copy is not a design that can work.
- Only 13 of 37 crates have an api.md at all. Missing include tampines, tuas_boussinesq_solver, teh-o-prke, njoy-outram-park-fork, chem-eng-real-time-process-control-simulator, outram-park-digital-twin-engine, bedok -- i.e. most of what a plant-modelling question would need.

MAINTAINER DECISIONS (asked and answered 2026-08-14):
1. Budget strategy: BOTH -- a condensed signature index covering ALL crates (always emitted, one file) PLUS verbatim api.md for the crates named on the command line.
2. Missing api.md: REGENERATE them first, via scripts/gen_api_docs.py.
3. Layout: ONE FLAT FILE PER CRATE.

NOTE ON DECISION 2 AND KOVAN'S CHARTER. Regenerating shells out to python3 + nightly rustdoc + rustdoc-md: not offline, not deterministic, and it would add ~2.4 MB to an already over-budget corpus. That was put to the maintainer and chosen anyway. It is reconciled by making regeneration an EXPLICIT OPT-IN FLAG that is off by default, exactly as 'kovan setup' already handles its online cargo-install path ('never run automatically, and has no bearing on the rest of kovan's offline/Android-clean operation'). The default invocation stays deterministic and offline.

PLACEMENT: logic in kovan-semantics as a new agent_docs module (repository-understanding artifact, sibling to outputs::repository_summary_markdown); kovan-cli stays a thin clap wrapper, per the workspace 'ports as modules, not new crates' rule.

OUTPUT: /agent-docs/ at the workspace root, regenerable and gitignored.
title: kovan agent-docs-gen: bundle Outram Park API docs for an external 200k-context agent
